mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.target_type AS targetType, c.target_id AS targetId, CASE WHEN c.target_type = 1 THEN a.title WHEN c.target_type = 2 THEN m.title END AS targetTitle, c.content, c.nickname, c.avatar, c.email, c.website, c.status, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(c.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM t_comment c LEFT JOIN t_article a ON c.target_type = 1 AND c.target_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_article m ON c.target_type = 2 AND c.target_id = m.id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.target_type = #{param.targetType} AND c.status = #{param.status} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC
